note: Stories cluster the last 24 hours of collector items. Summaries come only from item titles and feed summaries; open the links before citing details.

stories.headline: IRGC says tankers hit mines or caught fire in Strait of Hormuz
stories.summary: Iran's IRGC Navy said up to four oil tankers, including a supertanker with over 2 million barrels, were stopped, hit mines or caught fire after using a southern route it called unauthorised. UKMTO said a tanker was struck by explosives attached by a small boat, and Oman rescued 25 crew off Musandam. Analysts note limpet mines are a familiar Iranian tactic, which undercuts US claims that the strait was cleared.
stories.turkey: Disruption in Hormuz pushes energy prices up and raises risk for Türkiye's import bill and regional trade.

stories.headline: US weighs renewed strikes on Iran after midterms, Gulf states warned
stories.summary: Reports say Washington told Gulf states to prepare for a short, intense round of strikes on Iran after the November 3 midterms, and Senator Murphy said he was briefed on a plan to restart the war. Netanyahu is reportedly pushing for fresh strikes, while Israeli defence officials doubt a brief air campaign could topple Iran or end its nuclear programme. Axios reports Trump did not discuss strikes with the CENTCOM commander, and Haaretz says the threat is being used as leverage for talks.
stories.turkey: A renewed US-Iran war would hit Türkiye's southern neighbourhood, border security and energy supply.

stories.headline: Qatari mediators return to Tehran to revive US-Iran deal
stories.summary: A Qatari delegation led by a senior adviser to the prime minister made its second Tehran visit in a week, holding over 12 hours of talks on a US proposal. Iran International reports Iran rejected an earlier proposal and that the sides are deadlocked over who concedes first. Araghchi says Iran's seven-day plan could be implemented quickly.
stories.turkey: A US-Iran deal would lower regional escalation risk and reduce pressure on Türkiye's energy and border security.

stories.summary: Reports say US Vice President Vance offered to meet Iranian Supreme National Security Council secretary Mohsen Rezaei to discuss ending the war. A disclosed letter prompted contradictory narratives in Washington and a conditional response in Tehran. Rezaei is reportedly in contact with Supreme Leader Mojtaba Khamenei.

stories.summary: Trump said in a radio interview that the war will end soon and he expects it wrapped up before the midterms, without giving details. He said the US needs a guarantee Iran will never have a nuclear weapon. Vance said Trump will not let the confrontation become a forever war.

stories.headline: Oil surges on Hormuz attacks as BP posts record profit
stories.summary: Oil rose above $114 as traders brace for Iran escalation after the midterms, with Brent over 60 percent above pre-war levels. BP reported its highest profit in about two decades from the Middle East war. Merz says higher energy prices have cost Europe over €100 billion, and EU states agreed to speed the release of 42.6 million barrels from reserves.
stories.turkey: High and volatile energy prices strain Türkiye's inflation and current account, as its central bank noted.
